# Licences of the Rust crates of `hecate-doc-native`

This file is generated by `lua tools/run.lua gen-rust-licences` from `packages/doc/native/Cargo.lock` (Cargo.lock SHA-256: `9416bb387337d719d662eec09acffed08a48e30f46b4e68e2d47e4d0ca65d690`) and is
checked against it by the same task (`--check`). Do not edit it: change the dependencies, then run the task.

It reproduces, for every crate of the normal dependency graph of the module on the platforms Hecate builds for
(the targets of `deny.toml`: the crates that are compiled into the native module, and the procedural macros that
build it), the licence files found in the source of the crate (`LICENSE*`, `LICENCE*`, `COPYING*`, `NOTICE*`,
`UNICODE*`, `COPYRIGHT*`).
Identical texts are given once. Build-only and development dependencies are not listed.

When a crate offers a choice (`MIT OR Apache-2.0`), Hecate relies on the first alternative, in the order the
crate declares it, that the allow list of `deny.toml` accepts (column "Relied on"), else on the first
permissive alternative; an `AND` requires every term. The texts of the other
alternatives are reproduced when the crate ships them. A crate that declares an SPDX identifier and ships no
licence file is given the standard SPDX text of that identifier, marked in the column "Notes": the
placeholders of the standard text (year, copyright holders) are kept as they are.
